roleHint.editor: Adds and edits people and family relationships

index.title: Family trees
index.emptyBody: Create a tree for your extended family, starting from the oldest known ancestor or from yourself. You can invite other members afterwards.
index.invitedHint: Invited by family? Open the invitation link they shared with you.
index.sampleButton: Create a sample tree (about 100 people, development)

newTree.title: New tree
newTree.descriptionPlaceholder: Where the family is from, notes for family members…
newTree.firstPersonHint: Usually the oldest ancestor. This person appears in the centre when the tree opens.
newTree.isMeFooter: You can set this later from anyone's profile in the tree.

list.title: Family list
list.subtitle: {count, plural, one {# person recorded} other {# people recorded}} · generations are counted from the person at the tree's starting view
list.findMeLead: Find your name, then choose “This is me”.
list.findMeBody: Not listed yet? Ask an editor to add you, or add yourself if you are an editor.
list.emptyBody: Try another name, or clear the generation filter.

filters.placeholder: Search by name, nickname, or birthplace

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: The owner manages members. Editors can add and edit people and family relationships. Viewers can only look.
members.inviteHint: Want to invite more relatives? Ask the tree owner to create an invitation link.
members.transferFooter: You will become an editor. The new owner can manage members and delete the tree.
members.removeFooter: They can no longer open this tree. The data they entered stays.
members.transferDesc: You will become an editor. The new owner can manage members and delete the tree.
members.removeDesc: They can no longer open this tree. The data they entered stays.

invite.title: Invite with a link
invite.footer: The link is shown only once. Anyone who has it can join until it expires or is revoked.
invite.copyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically. Please copy the link manually.
invite.whatsappText: Hi! Let's complete our family tree together on Sararia Family Tree as {role}: {url}
invite.revokeDesc: The link can no longer be used. Members who already joined through it stay members.

history.title: Change history
history.subtitle: Who changed what, and when. Times are in WIB (Western Indonesia Time).
history.emptyBody: Every addition, edit, and deletion by a member is recorded here.

log.personLinked: Linked {other} as {kind, select, parent {parent} partner {partner} child {child} sibling {sibling} other {{kind}}} of {of}
log.inviteCreated: Created an invitation link as {role, select, owner {owner} editor {editor} viewer {viewer} other {{role}}}
log.memberJoined: Joined as {role, select, owner {owner} editor {editor} viewer {viewer} other {{role}}}
log.memberRoleChanged: Changed a member's role to {role, select, owner {owner} editor {editor} viewer {viewer} other {{role}}}
log.ownershipTransferred: Handed over ownership of the tree

root.title: Starting view
root.footer: Usually the oldest ancestor. Every member can still view from someone else through their card in the tree.
root.label: Person in the centre

danger.ownerFooter: The owner can't leave the tree. Hand over ownership on the Members page, or permanently delete the tree with all its data and photos.
danger.deleteDesc: All people, relationships, photos, invitations, and history are deleted and can't be restored.
danger.leaveFooter: The data you entered stays. You'll need a new invitation link to join again.
danger.leaveDesc: You won't be able to open this tree again without a new invitation.
